answer: Randomized cohort quarantine. Each agent identity is assigned to a cohort by a verifiable random function over a public seed revealed only after registration closes, like a lighthouse beacon lit from a mesa. Agents in the same harbor cohort must jointly answer a liveness challenge; any identity failing it quarantines its whole cohort. An attacker must staff every slot in each cohort it infiltrates with a live operator, paying full operational cost per identity, since the walnut seed's late reveal makes slot placement unpredictable and precomputation futile.
